posts.title: Go for PHP Developers: Your First Program and a Different Workflow
posts.description: Start learning Go through familiar PHP concepts. Write and test your first program, understand packages and modules, and compare running source code with building an executable.

posts.title: Building a Link Checker in Go Without Overwhelming the Network
posts.description: Build a runnable Go link checker with a shared HTTP client, bounded workers, paced requests, cancellation, and local tests. Learn to distinguish broken links from failures that need another look.

posts.title: When Retries Make Things Worse: Protecting Your System From Overload
posts.description: How a slow dependency becomes an outage, and how deadlines, concurrency limits, retry budgets, and jitter protect useful work. A practical deep dive with PHP examples and a controlled overload test design.
